name: wds_imagenetv2
description: ImageNetV2 is a re-collected test set intended to measure generalization and distribution-shift robustness of ImageNet-trained image classification models. It contains images sampled and labeled using a protocol similar to the original ImageNet validation set to provide a more realistic estimate of out-of-sample performance. The benchmark is used to compare top-1/top-5 accuracy under a natural shift from the original ImageNet distribution.
reputation: Widely used and respected in the computer vision community as a standard test of ImageNet-trained models' robustness to distribution shift.
